accessor_comment: AVolumetricCloud has no public component getter, so the component is found by class.
header_comment: SetReflectionViewSampleCountScale and SetShadowReflectionViewSampleCountScale are left out: the fields
they write are Value-suffixed, next to deprecated fields of the plain name.
set_desc: Set layer and planet geometry, ground albedo, tracing distances and sample counts of a VolumetricCloud actor found by label or name, through the component's setters, which refresh its render state; set_properties writes any other field. Only supplied fields change, in one undo step (applied_count counts them), and the reply reads every property back. ground_albedo is [R,G,B(,A)] in whole 0-255 bytes. A malformed field, or a component of Static mobility (its setters change nothing; make it Movable first), is an error and nothing changes. Not saved.
get_desc: Read the layer and tracing settings of a VolumetricCloud actor's component, found by label or name in the editor world, under the snake_case names set_volumetric_cloud_properties takes. A curated view; get_properties (internal names only) reads any other UPROPERTY on the component.

fields.desc: Optional [R,G,B] or [R,G,B,A] ground albedo, each a whole number from 0 to 255 (FColor; A defaults to 255).
Optional sky light cloud bottom occlusion (0..1).
Optional shadow view sample count scale.
